states.not_started: No execution under this gate. Listed blockers are known missing evidence.
states.blocked: Started or inspected; named evidence is missing and dependent execution must stop.
states.unknown: The state could not be observed.
states.failed: Prescribed criteria were applied and refused the result. A failed gate stays failed; a new attempt is a new gate revision.
states.investigated: The investigation is complete and documented; it records blockers and cannot by itself pass an engineering gate.
states.engineering_passed: Every prerequisite passed, all bindings and configuration pins matched, receipts verified and, for physical correlation or manufacturing, a documented professional review exists.

opening_rule: A gate may open only through baseline.py evaluate_gate: every prerequisite engineering_passed, no open blocker, every bound runtime row attested with the same variant, version and platform, every bound identity pinned (never 'unknown') and attested byte-for-byte equal, every configuration pin still matching the repository and attested equal, at least one verified execution receipt, and a review receipt for physical correlation and manufacturing release. A stale or mismatched binary or configuration hash refuses the gate.

release_separation.numerical_comparison: G08 (compressor) and G10 (whole turbo, with uncertainty) report numerical results within a labelled domain. They are not physical correlation.
release_separation.physical_correlation: R2 requires time-stamped bench measurements correlated with the numerical model; it is false until then.
release_separation.manufacturing_release: R3 requires documented professional engineering review, an approved validation plan and material/process qualification. A turbocharger is a highly loaded engine part under AGENTS.md; this roadmap authorises neither fabrication nor physical testing.

paired_comparison_contract.purpose: Defines, before any application, what a reference-versus-bionic comparison measures and what it may claim.

reference.claim: baseline.json: volute radius law 6 + 8t mm with the conical F0 chamber

bionic.claim: candidate.json: volute radius law sqrt(36 + 160t) mm with the same wheel and conical F0 chamber

excluded.claim: candidate-combined.json is rejected for the current CFD (wheel/housing distance below 0.4 mm)
candidate-shroud.json is an exploratory parameterisation without a standalone run

pair.pairing_rule: Both variants use the same wheel, seals and closures, inlet and outlet extensions, mesh route, solver runtime row, criteria and operating point. Any difference other than the volute law makes the pair invalid.

rotor_speed.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

inlet_total_pressure.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

inlet_total_temperature.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

outlet_static_pressure.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement; the ratio is static/total, not total/total

measured_operating_conditions.claim: measured speed, inlet state, back-pressure and engine operating points

unknown.reason: no measured turbo map or bench data exists; issue 396 must source them or keep them unknown

mass_flow.definition: Mass flow rate in kg/s, an output of the solver at imposed back-pressure (never imposed to obtain a better result), integrated over the measurement sections outside the MRF zone. Inlet and outlet must agree within the prescribed relative mass imbalance.
mass_flow.not_claimed: A single point at imposed back-pressure demonstrates neither maximum flow nor choking; maximum flow needs a back-pressure sweep at identical speed.

shaft_power.definition: Compressor wheel aerodynamic input power P = -omega * M_z in W, where M_z is the native fluid-on-rotor moment (pressure plus viscous) about +Z on the rotor patch. It must be positive and equal the net outward total-enthalpy flux sum(phi*(h + |U_absolute|^2/2)) at the ports outside the MRF, within the prescribed energy imbalance; no absolute value may hide a sign inversion.
shaft_power.not_claimed: It excludes bearing, seal and disc-friction losses outside the domain. It is the power absorbed by the compressor, not engine power, and not turbine power; the shaft balance P_turbine = P_compressor + losses belongs to G09.

acceptance_before_ranking: Each variant passes the extended mesh checks and the prescribed history criteria (window, residual, mean change, standard deviation, peak-to-peak) defined before the calculation.
Each variant is computed on several meshes of the qualified route; the number of meshes and their refinement ratio are prescribed in issue 399/400 before application, never chosen after results.
A ranking is reported only when the paired difference exceeds the combined numerical uncertainty quantified in issue 403; otherwise the result is indeterminate.
Failed points and refused meshes are retained; no threshold is relaxed.

separation.numerical_comparison: G08 and G10 only; labelled domain and numerical uncertainty.
separation.physical_correlation: R2 only; requires measured bench data; false today.
separation.manufacturing_release: R3 only; requires professional engineering review; false today.
